about_the_game:
Welcome to Lord Fenrir’s Banquet!
Now, now—Lord Fenrir is waiting, stomach growling with anticipation!
Please, take your time and enjoy this feast to the fullest tonight...

How to Play

  • First, throw a carrot onto the stage!

  • If you move the carrot near a rabbit, it will come closer.

  • Lead the rabbit to Lord Fenrir.

  • Feed the rabbit to Lord Fenrir to increase your score!

Power Up When the Gauge Is Full

When the on-screen gauge reaches MAX, you'll power up!
Carrots will become enhanced for a limited time, drawing rabbits from farther away.
Feeding multiple rabbits to Lord Fenrir at once is the key to charging the gauge faster!

More Rabbits Appear as You Level Up

After clearing each stage, achieving a high enough score will level you up!
As you level up, more rabbits will appear on the stage, allowing you to aim for even higher scores!

  • This game supports mouse, keyboard, and controller input.

pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Atom / Core i3 (2nd generation) or higher
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics (integrated GPU is sufficient)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Standard onboard sound is sufficient
  • VR Support: Not supported
  • Additional Notes: This is a very lightweight game, but please note that Windows 7 / 8 have not been tested, and the game may not function properly on those systems.

short_description: Welcome to Fenrir Banquet! Control the carrot to guide the rabbit to Fenrir and feed it! Can you satisfy Fenrir?
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Arabic, Indonesian, Dutch, Greek, Swedish, Spanish - Latin America, Thai, Turkish, Vietnamese, Portuguese - Brazil, Portuguese - Portugal, Polish, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Hindi, Bangla
